svg.text: KKFM TX shield - schematic (rev A, proposed)
Left = source pin, right = destination pin. One ground net, solid bottom-layer plane. All passives 0603 unless noted.
C1/C2 within 3 mm of U1 Vin+GND pins
separate bead: DAC clock hash stays off the RF rail
every module GND pin drops straight to the plane by its own via
glitch filter, tau 47 us; sketch holds reset 5 ms
series damping at the Uno end
U1 CS, GP1, GP2, 3Vo: no connect (white GP2 wire removed)
AUDIO (RF/ultrasonic low-pass, fc 34 kHz, -0.15 dB in band; live peaks measured -6 dBFS)
R6/R7: fit 2k2 with R4/R5=10k only if the DAC is ever run at full scale
source-series damping at the Pi end of the link
5 V -> 3.3 V divider; Pi GPIO is not 5 V tolerant
optional: lets the Pi reset/flash the Uno with no button press
antenna leaves the board at the corner farthest from the Pi link
